name: jo-wolff-plugins
description: What an agent's output is made of, what shape it arrives in, and when an agent may write code: published for anyone to install.

plugins.name: output-types
plugins.description: Type and receipt every statement an agent returns, so a reader can tell what was checked from what was assumed.

plugins.name: communication-rules
plugins.description: Shape a message around what it needs from its reader — decisions first, one closing ask, no batching by label — and record which of those rules a machine can actually check.

plugins.name: paired-coding
plugins.description: Pair with an agent one change set at a time: it proposes a card naming the decision inside the change, you agree in conversation, and a gate at the tool boundary refuses every write outside the agreed change set. Gate on Claude Code and OMP, on macOS and Linux.
